subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Wolf as Outsider
description: One-minute skill: The Wolf as Outsider.

hook.text: Little Red Riding Hood fears the wolf. Romulus and Remus were raised by one. Savior or predator—the wolf splits.

buildup.text: In Europe, wolves symbolized danger and the wilderness. They were hunted to extinction in most countries.

discovery.text: In Norse myth, Fenrir the wolf devours Odin at Ragnarök. The wolf destroys the highest god—pure untamed chaos.

twist.text: Native American traditions honor the wolf as teacher and pathfinder. The same animal Europe demonized, others revered.

climax.text: The wolf represents whatever a culture fears or admires about the wild. It mirrors humanity's bond with nature.

punchline.text: Fear the wolf. Or follow it. Your choice.

quiz.question: Which Norse wolf devours Odin at Ragnarök?
